scenes.title: Six friends. One booking.
scenes.narration: Six friends want to do pottery. One person has a private budget. Another is leaving town. And nobody wants to pay for everyone. This is Rally.

scenes.title: Your budget stays yours.
scenes.actor: Alex’s private view · Recorded before booking
scenes.narration: Each friend adds what works for them. Alex can spend fifty dollars and wants to make a cup. Their spending limit stays private. The organizer sees who is ready, not anyone else’s budget.

scenes.title: One sentence. One useful question.
scenes.actor: Sam’s private view · Actual AI clarification
scenes.narration: Sam writes, I leave Friday. Does that prevent attending, or collecting the fired piece later? Rally asks what needs to happen with the piece after the session. Sam confirms the collection need. The AI proposes a question; it cannot change Sam’s choices or agree for a friend.

scenes.title: A little help from a friend.
scenes.actor: Jordan’s view · After both fictional users agreed
scenes.narration: Sam chooses Jordan to collect the piece after firing, shares that specific request, and Jordan separately agrees. Now the published hand-building session fits their confirmed requirements at forty-eight dollars each. No one’s private budget is exposed.

scenes.title: The studio makes room.
scenes.actor: Willow Studio · Review, then reserved · Recorded cuts
scenes.narration: The studio reviews the exact session, six-person roster, price, cancellation terms and collection agreement. It blocks the session including setup and cleanup, then opens a two-hour window for everyone to approve. Availability comes from the studio’s commitment, not an AI guess.

scenes.title: Pay your share in PayPal.
scenes.actor: Alex · Sandbox checkout, then authorization · Recorded cuts
scenes.narration: Every friend reviews the same offer and approves only their own forty-eight-dollar share in PayPal sandbox. PayPal first authorizes that payment. Rally waits for all six distinct buyers to qualify before collecting the agreed payments. Returning from PayPal alone is not proof that a payment completed.

scenes.title: See you at the studio.
scenes.actor: Same six-person offer · Six captures verified
scenes.narration: All six captures completed for the same booking: two hundred eighty-eight dollars in sandbox payments. Only then did Rally confirm the reserved session. Each friend paid their share. Nobody fronted the group’s bill.

scenes.title: A failed payment cannot become a booking.
scenes.actor: Separate three-buyer test · Local worker, actual PayPal sandbox
scenes.narration: Here is a separate three-buyer recovery test. We deliberately canceled one authorization after the first capture. Rally aborted the booking, refunded forty-eight dollars and voided the other two authorizations. A separate dropped-response test recovered the existing capture after a worker restart without charging again.

scenes.title: Make the plan. Share the moment.
scenes.actor: rally.gowthamsarveswaran.com · Private judge access code required
scenes.narration: Rally. A plan that fits everyone. Everyone pays their own share. Try the judge demo.
